newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: New Zimbabwe bank plans public share offer.
newsitem.headline: New Zimbabwe bank plans public share offer.

text.p: Zimbabwe's newest commercial bank, First Banking Corp Ltd, is planning a public share offer later this year to increase its capital base and broaden its ownership, managing director Webster Masvikwa said on Tuesday.
He declined to give details of the offer save to say the bank's board would be making an announcement "soon".
"Plans are underway to make a public share offer. The whole objective is to broaden ownership and participation in the bank," he said.
The bank, owned by black Zimbabwean businesses and which entered the market in early July, currently has an authorised share capital of Z$100 million, Z$50 million of which is issued and paid up.

Local black-owned mining concern Africa Resources Ltd and the Zimbabwe Industrial Development Corp run by Vice President Joshua Nkomo own 25 percent each of the bank's shareholding, its workers have a five percent stake while the remaining 45 percent is held by three undisclosed individuals.
